_translation.note: Spec section 12 requires HUMAN translation for: the consent text, both signature documents, the privacy notice, and every tax ID validation error. Keys under `esign`, `privacy`, and `validation.ssn` / `validation.itin` / `validation.tin` are marked `needsCounselReview` in the Spanish catalogue and must be replaced with copy approved by the client's counsel in English and human-translated to Spanish before launch. Machine translation is not acceptable for those.
_translation.designWidth: Every screen is designed at Spanish string lengths and tested at 360px.

workerInvite.subject: {company}: your onboarding information is needed
workerInvite.body:
{company} has asked you to complete your onboarding information.

It takes about five minutes. You will be asked for your legal name, address, date of birth, tax ID number, and bank details for direct deposit.

{company} will not see what you enter. It goes only to their accounting firm, who use it to pay you and file your taxes.

Start here:
{url}

The link works once and expires in seven days. You can stop part-way and come back to it — your answers are saved as you go.

ownerInvite.subject: {company}: your owner information is needed
ownerInvite.body:
{company} has asked you to provide your owner information for tax filing.

It takes about three minutes. You will be asked for your legal name, address, date of birth, and tax ID number.

Start here:
{url}

The link works once and expires in seven days.

reminder.subject: Reminder from {company}: your onboarding is not finished
reminder.body:
Your onboarding for {company} is not complete yet.

Here is a fresh link — the previous one no longer works:
{url}

It takes about five minutes and expires in seven days.

staffSetup.subject: Set up your Onboarding account
staffSetup.body:
Hello {name},

An account has been created for you on the Onboarding platform.

Set your password and enrol your authenticator app here. The link works once and expires in 24 hours:

{url}

If you were not expecting this, you can ignore this message and the link will expire on its own.

needsAttention.subject: Onboarding needs attention

verify.title: First, confirm your date of birth
verify.body: {company} sent you this link. To make sure it reached the right person, enter your date of birth.
verify.why: Your employer does not know your date of birth, so this keeps the link from working for anyone else.

expired.title: This link is no longer valid
expired.body: Links can be used once and expire after seven days.
expired.next: Ask the company that sent it to you for a new one.

locked.title: This link is locked
locked.body: Too many incorrect answers. Try again in an hour. If you did not make those attempts, tell the company that sent you this link.

welcome.title: {company} needs some information from you
welcome.what: We will ask for your legal name, address, date of birth, tax ID number, and bank details for direct deposit.
welcome.privacy: {company} will not see what you enter here. It goes only to their accounting firm, who use it to pay you and file your taxes.
welcome.time: It takes about five minutes. You can stop and come back to this link at any point — your answers are saved as you go.

name.title: What is your full legal name?
name.hint: Exactly as it appears on your Social Security card or ITIN letter.
name.middleHint: Leave blank if you do not have one.

dob.title: Is this your date of birth?
dob.hint: This is what you entered a moment ago.
dob.label: Date of birth

contact.title: How can we reach you?
contact.phoneHint: So the accounting firm can reach you about your paperwork.
contact.emailHint: Optional. Only used if we need to reach you about your paperwork.

emergency.title: Emergency contact
emergency.hint: Optional. Someone we should call if something happens at work.
emergency.name: Name

tinType.title: Which tax ID number do you have?
tinType.hint: Choose the one that matches the document you hold.

SSN.title: Social Security Number
SSN.body: A nine-digit number on a Social Security card, issued by the Social Security Administration.

ITIN.title: ITIN
ITIN.body: An Individual Taxpayer Identification Number, issued by the IRS in a letter. It always starts with 9.

tin.title: Enter your tax ID number
tin.hint: Nine digits. Nobody at your workplace will see this.

bank.title: Where should you be paid?
bank.hint: This is the account your pay will be deposited into.
bank.name: Name of your bank

routing.title: Routing number
routing.hint: Nine digits, usually the leftmost number at the bottom of a check.

account.title: Account number
account.hint: Between 4 and 17 digits, to the right of the routing number.
account.label: Account number

check.title: Photo of a voided check
check.hint: This helps the accounting firm confirm your account details.
check.optional: This step is optional. You can finish without it.
check.takeHint: Or choose one from your phone.

notes.title: Anything else we should know?
notes.label: Notes
notes.privacy: Only the accounting firm reads this. Your employer does not see it.

sign.nameMismatch: This does not match the name you gave earlier ({expected}). You can still continue if this is how you sign your name.

done.title: All done
done.body: Thank you. Your information has gone to the accounting firm for {company}.
done.corrections: If something needs to change later, tell the company and they will send you a new link.

errors.dobFormat: Choose a month, day, and year.
errors.dobWrong: That does not match. Please check the date and try again.
errors.dobWrongRemaining: That does not match. You have {remaining} attempts left before this link is locked for an hour.

companies.title: Client companies
companies.empty: No companies yet. Add one to get started.

new.title: Add a company
new.adminHint: They will be emailed a link, valid for 24 hours and usable once, to choose a password and enrol an authenticator app. You never set a password for them.

workers.title: {count} workers
workers.empty: No workers have been added yet.
workers.name: Name

worker.personalHint: Supplied by the worker. The company never sees this.
worker.notSubmitted: This worker has not submitted their information yet.
worker.historyHint: Corrections write a new version and preserve the old one.

owners.title: {count} owners
owners.empty: No owners have been invited yet.
owners.name: Name

reveal.title: Reveal {field}
reveal.reason: Why do you need to see this?
reveal.reasonHint: At least ten characters. This is recorded permanently against your name.
reveal.codeHint: A fresh six-digit code from your authenticator app.
reveal.notice: The value will be shown for 30 seconds and then hidden again.

errors.notFound: That record could not be found.
errors.noValue: There is no value recorded for that field.

export.title: Export
export.intro: Builds a password-protected archive containing workers.csv, owners.csv, and the documents on file. The archive is deleted from the platform 24 hours after it is created.
export.sensitiveLabel: Include unmasked tax ID and bank account numbers
export.sensitiveWarning: Every value will be decrypted individually and each decryption is recorded in the audit log against your name and the reason below. Leave this unchecked unless the work genuinely requires the full numbers.
export.reasonHint: At least ten characters. Recorded permanently and included in the archive.
export.passwordBody: This is shown once. It is not stored, and it will never be emailed or texted to you. Copy it somewhere safe before you leave this page.
export.passwordWarning: If you lose it, the archive cannot be opened and you will need to create a new export.
export.failed: The export could not be built. Nothing was disclosed; try again.

staff.title: Firm staff
staff.intro: Everyone at your firm with access to this platform.
staff.invited: Invited. A setup link has been emailed to them.
staff.name: Name
staff.roleHint: Firm staff can reveal a single field at a time with a reason, and cannot export. Firm admins can also export, manage staff, and add client companies.

revoke.title: Access to this company
revoke.hint: Ending access removes this company from every person at your firm on their next request. The grant record is kept and stamped, so who had access and until when stays answerable.
revoke.confirmBody: This company will disappear from your firm immediately. Re-granting access requires the platform administrator.

correct.title: Correct a record
correct.intro: This writes version {version} plus one and keeps the current version. Nothing is overwritten.
correct.sensitiveHint: Leave these blank unless the value itself is wrong. A blank field keeps the stored value exactly as it is — it is not decrypted, not shown, and not re-encrypted.
correct.reason: What is being corrected, and why?
correct.reasonHint: At least ten characters. Recorded permanently against your name.
correct.done: Correction saved. The previous version is kept in the history below.
correct.noRecord: This worker has no current record to correct.

dashboard.title: Onboarding
dashboard.allDone: Everything is complete. Your accounting firm has what it needs.

workers.title: Workers
workers.name: Name
workers.privacyNote: You will see whether each person has finished, and nothing else. Their legal name, date of birth, tax ID and bank details go directly to your accounting firm and are never shown here — including the last four digits.

inviteWorker.title: Invite a worker
inviteWorker.intro: They will receive an email with a link. They enter their own personal and banking information; you will only see whether they have finished.
inviteWorker.personHint: Enough to send them the link.
inviteWorker.displayNameHint: How you refer to them. It does not have to be their full legal name.
inviteWorker.languageHint: The language their form and text messages will be in.
inviteWorker.phoneHint: Optional. Only so you can reach them if they get stuck.
inviteWorker.payrollHint: You enter these. The worker does not see or change them.
inviteWorker.emailHint: The invite link is sent here. It must be an address they control personally — not one on your company's domain, because you would be able to read it.

owners.title: Owners
owners.name: Name
owners.privacyNote: Each owner supplies their own Social Security number or ITIN through their own link, including you. You will see whether they have submitted, and nothing else.

inviteOwner.title: Invite an owner
inviteOwner.intro: They will receive an email with a link and supply their own name, date of birth, address and tax ID. If you are an owner yourself, invite yourself here — the process is the same.
inviteOwner.percentHint: Optional. Warned about, not enforced, if the total is not 100.
inviteOwner.emailHint: The invite link is sent here. It must be an address they control personally — not one on your company's domain.

profile.title: Company profile
profile.operatingHint: Every state you have workers in. Workers' compensation and state tax rules differ in each.
profile.exemptHint: Upload your exemption document on the Documents page. Exemption rules and the acceptable proof vary by state.

banking.title: Company bank account
banking.intro: This is your company's own account. It is stored encrypted, shown masked, and revealing it is recorded.
banking.hint: Enter the account your company uses. This is not any worker's account.

documents.title: Documents
documents.intro: Articles of incorporation, insurance policies, and anything else your accounting firm has asked for.
documents.label: Description
documents.fileHint: PDF or image, up to 25 MB.

errors.noValue: There is nothing recorded for that field.
errors.employerMailbox: That address is on your company's own email domain, which means you could read the invite and open the link yourself. Use an address the person controls personally.

errors.type: That file type is not accepted. Use a PDF or an image.
errors.tooLarge: That file is too large. The limit is 25 MB.

platform.title: Firms
platform.subtitle: Counts and activity shapes. No company data is visible to this role.
platform.firmCreated: Firm created. A setup link has been emailed to its administrator.
platform.suspendConfirm: This signs out every member of this firm.
platform.activityHint: Actions and volumes only. Reasons, targets and company names are deliberately omitted — this role cannot read worker data, and a reveal reason routinely names a person.

newFirm.title: Add a firm
newFirm.intro: Creates the firm and its first administrator.
newFirm.name: Firm name
newFirm.adminHint: The one account nobody else can create — there is no firm session that could have made it. They get a 24-hour setup link and choose their own password and authenticator. Everything after this the firm does for itself.
